core_thesis: EdgeQoS is not a system that assumes its AI is always correct. It is a QoS controller designed to remain safe when its AI is uncertain or wrong.

false_demotion_voice_in_cs0.protection_mechanism: CAKE Deficit Round Robin (DRR+) per-flow deficit scheduling

false_promotion_bulk_in_cs5.protection_mechanism: Behavioral Rate Guard (4 Hz conntrack rate supervision)
